en: Black‑and‑white view of a grand European spa‑town street bordered by ornate 19th‑century buildings. In the foreground is a curved park or promenade with trees and a wide carriage road where an early automobile and a horse‑drawn carriage are visible. On the right stand tall hotels with many shuttered windows and balconies; the most prominent bears large signage for "HOTEL KLINGER". Shops and arcades line the street level, and forested hills rise in the background, suggesting a resort valley setting.
